purpose: Original-game browser execution feasibility, not a working title runtime

source.scope: Native-web feasibility candidate; not an accepted complete runtime
source.note: Locally retained kernel-replacement source at the pinned commit. Its AvSendTVEncoderOption option-6 word (0x00400104) is a synthetic D3D compatibility default chosen for mode-table matching (host/kernel/kernel_hal.c:1463-1510), not an original-kernel observation. Ordinal 2 remains unsupported.

nativeRecompProbe.storage: Ignored recomp-venv only; no global dependency changes

sdkRecompilation.scope: Primary SDK integration candidate. Local native developer reference execution is permitted with matching player-owned inputs; it does not accept M1. Browser candidates require their own reviewed manifest/admission and remain separate from the unchanged M44 proof. Original inputs and generated title artifacts stay local.

browserReference.scope: Browser platform reference; preserve current toolchain/memory guards and review component provenance before reuse.

cxbx.note: Public source read at the cited commit. Numeric option 6 is AV_QUERY_AV_CAPABILITIES in host/core/kernel/common/xbox.h and is handled in EmuKrnlAv.cpp by AvQueryAvCapabilities(); it is not a no-op and does not define AV_OPTION_QUERY_AVPACK. This differs from the xboxrecomp option-6 mapping. Option 6 remains unsupported; no source is stored locally.

compiler.digestBoundary: Locally measured installed binaries from official SDK acquisition; not independently verified published digests. SDK Node is compiler tooling only; project runtime pin remains Node 24.14.0.

zlib.localState: Wasm archive built and CRC/compression ABI check passed; not original-game execution

glib.localState: Wasm static libraries installed; detected by xemu runtime-02 as 2.84.0; original-game behavior untested

libffi.localState: Wasm archive installed; signed32/uint64/double foreign-call ABI check passed

pixman.localState: Wasm archive installed from upstream dependency recipe; current xemu probe flags skip pixman; no render validation

pcre2.verification: Both archives matched the wrap pins in published-digest-verified GLib source
pcre2.localState: Built and installed as part of GLib

sdl3.localState: Unmodified source cross-built with Emscripten backends/pthreads; Wasm thread/PCM check passed; browser GL readback, keyboard and silent audio callback check passed with wasm32-dyncall adapter

storage: Sources, SDK, cross libraries, logs and compiled output stay in ignored .tools/emulation; no global activation or Xbox firmware/game acquisition.
limits: A successful cross-build would not establish browser execution, game compatibility, fidelity, network authority or performance.
